howIWork.heading: What working with me looks like.

items.text: End-to-end ownership. Comfortable taking a feature from a half-formed Figma or a paragraph of requirements all the way through frontend, backend, infrastructure, and deploy — without needing handoffs along the way.

TypeScript across the stack: React / Next.js on the web, React Native (Expo) on mobile, NestJS/Fastify/Express on the server. CI/CD, testing, Docker by default; self-host infra when it makes sense, happy on AWS / Vercel / Hetzner when it doesn't.

Agentic AI is core to how I work — I've built my own tooling around it, so agents handle the typing while I drive architecture, review, and integration. I can also set up and run the infrastructure itself — self-hosted inference, gateways, routing — which I do day-to-day on corporate stacks. Net effect: meaningfully more shipped per week than a hands-on-keyboard pace.
Async-friendly and used to working with US clients from Sofia, Bulgaria (UTC+2). Work in English, Ukrainian, and Russian.

contact.heading: The fastest way to reach me is email.
contact.body: I read everything that lands in my inbox and reply within a day. Tell me a bit about the project — stack, timeline, what you're trying to ship — and we'll go from there. If you're in Sofia, I'm happy to meet in person — at your office, or at my coworking (WorkBetter 1.0) if that's easier.
